name: visual-explainer
description: Agent skill that generates rich HTML pages or slide decks for diagrams, diff reviews, plan audits, data tables, and project recaps
readme_summary: Visual-explainer is an agent skill that transforms complex terminal output, such as diagrams and tables, into user-friendly, styled HTML pages. It aims to make information generated by coding agents more readable and visually appealing, moving beyond basic ASCII art.
key_features: Generates styled HTML pages from terminal output
Supports diagrams, diff reviews, plan audits, data tables, and project recaps
Interactive Mermaid diagrams with zoom and pan
No build step or dependencies beyond a browser for basic use
Optional MCP and PPTX utilities with small Node dependencies
Multiple installation methods for various agent frameworks (Claude Code, Pi, MCP hosts, Antigravity CLI, Codex CLI, etc.)
primary_use_case: To enhance the readability and visual presentation of information generated by coding agents, converting raw terminal output into accessible and interactive HTML pages.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled cartographer in a dimly lit, ancient library, using a magical quill to transform tangled, scribbled scrolls (representing complex terminal output) into a beautifully illuminated, interactive map displayed on a large, glowing parchment (representing an HTML page). The map shows clear pathways and distinct landmarks (visualizing organized data and diagrams). Subtle digital particles emanate from the quill, and a small, stylized compass on the map bears the name 'visual-explainer'. The scene is rendered in a rich, detailed digital painting style with a focus on the contrast between the chaotic input and the elegant output.

name: editor
description: Open-source 3D architectural editor with a local CLI, MCP tools, and practical workflows for humans and AI agents.
readme_summary: Pascal Editor is an open-source, local-first 3D architectural editor that runs in the browser or via a CLI. It leverages React Three Fiber and WebGPU for its rendering capabilities and integrates with AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
key_features: React Three Fiber and WebGPU powered
CLI tools for project management and agent interaction
primary_use_case: To provide a flexible and extensible platform for creating and editing 3D architectural models, with a focus on local-first operation and seamless integration with AI agents for enhanced workflows.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled architect, depicted as a sculptor, is meticulously shaping a miniature, glowing 3D building model on a workbench. Instead of traditional tools, the architect uses a holographic interface that projects lines of code and abstract data streams, representing AI input. The building model is transforming from a basic wireframe into a detailed architectural structure, with blueprints unfurling around the scene. Subtle elements like floating data particles and a small, integrated screen showing the Pascal Editor UI connect the metaphor to the software. The scene is set in a modern, well-lit studio with an isometric perspective, rendered in a clean, 3D illustration style with a focus on clarity and detail.

name: OpenContext
description: A personal context store for AI agents and assistants—reuse your existing coding agent CLI (Codex/Claude/OpenCode) with built‑in Skills/tools and a desktop GUI to capture, search, and reuse project knowledge across agents and repos.
readme_summary: OpenContext is a personal context and knowledge store for AI agents, allowing them to maintain memory across sessions and projects. It integrates with existing coding agent CLIs (like Codex, Claude/OpenCode) and provides a GUI, skills, and tools to capture, search, and reuse project knowledge.
key_features: Desktop GUI for managing and searching contexts
Web UI for browsing and editing contexts
Skills and slash commands generation for agents
primary_use_case: To provide AI agents with a persistent memory and knowledge base, enabling them to retain context across different coding sessions, projects, and interactions, thereby improving efficiency and reducing repetition.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing a vast, glowing library where each book represents a coding project or a past conversation. The librarian uses a magical quill that writes directly into a digital interface, instantly creating new 'knowledge books' or retrieving existing ones. Small, ethereal AI assistants float around, reading from these books and gaining understanding. The library's architecture subtly incorporates elements of code and UI interfaces. The overall mood is one of organized intelligence and persistent memory, with soft, ambient lighting. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic, emphasizing the flow of information and knowledge.

name: Text-Grab
description: Use OCR in Windows quickly and easily with Text Grab. With optional background process and notifications.
readme_summary: Text Grab is a Windows application that uses Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to extract text from images, PDFs, and other on-screen content. It offers multiple capture modes, local processing for privacy, and integration options for seamless workflow integration.
key_features: OCR text extraction from various sources (screenshots, files)
Local and private processing (no internet required)
Multiple capture modes (Full-Screen, Window, Region, File)
Clipboard output and direct editor integration
Optional Windows AI features for enhanced accuracy on compatible hardware
primary_use_case: Extracting and copying text from any visible content on a Windows screen, especially from sources where text selection is not possible.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot hand gently lifting a glowing digital 'T' character from a complex, layered image of a screenshot, a PDF document, and a video frame. The robot hand is placing the extracted 'T' into a clean, minimalist clipboard icon. Subtle digital particles flow from the image sources towards the robot's 'scanner' eye, indicating the OCR process. The background is a soft, abstract representation of a Windows desktop. The overall mood is helpful and efficient, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with bright, clear colors and subtle glowing effects to highlight the extracted text and the OCR process.

name: PageLM
description: PageLM is a community driven version of NotebookLM & a education platform that transforms study materials into interactive resources like quizzes, flashcards, notes, and podcasts.
readme_summary: PageLM is an open-source AI-powered education platform that transforms study materials like PDFs and lecture notes into interactive learning resources. It aims to provide a community-driven alternative to tools like NotebookLM, offering features such as quizzes, flashcards, notes, and podcasts.
key_features: Generates quizzes, flashcards, notes, and podcasts
Built with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and LangChain
primary_use_case: To convert static study materials into dynamic, interactive learning tools using AI, making studying more engaging and effective.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old owl wearing spectacles, perched on a stack of books. In front of the owl, a digital projection screen displays a chaotic jumble of study notes and PDF pages. The owl is using its wing to point at the screen, and from its beak, a stream of organized, glowing icons representing quizzes, flashcards, and podcast microphones are emerging and neatly arranging themselves. Subtle UI elements of PageLM are visible on a small floating tablet nearby. The background is a warm, inviting library. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with soft, magical lighting and a clean, organized composition.

name: happy
description: Mobile and Web client for Codex and Claude Code, with realtime voice, encryption and fully featured
readme_summary: Happy is a cross-platform client for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex, offering mobile and web access with end-to-end encryption. It allows users to interact with their AI from anywhere, seamlessly switching between devices.
key_features: Mobile and Web client for Claude Code and Codex
primary_use_case: Enables users to access and control AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex from any device (mobile, web, desktop) with enhanced security and convenience.
cover_image_prompt: A split scene: on one side, a person is comfortably coding on a laptop in a modern office, with a glowing, abstract representation of an AI assistant beside them. On the other side, the same person is on a mobile phone, perhaps on a train or in a cafe, interacting with the same AI assistant, which is now visualized as a smaller, portable orb. A subtle, glowing thread connects the AI orbs on both devices, symbolizing seamless, encrypted communication. Small, stylized code snippets and data streams flow between the devices. The overall mood is one of effortless productivity and ubiquitous access. 3D isometric illustration style, clean lines, vibrant but not overwhelming colors, with the 'Happy' logo subtly integrated into a UI element.
